messages:
Maria (CS Ops): Heads-up — I'm starting a CRM hygiene sweep for accounts with stale onboarding (>90d). Planning to patch playbook triggers and tag candidates so CSMs get a routing signal.
Jamal (CS): Scope? which segments and ARR cutoff?
Maria (CS Ops): Top 250 by ARR, ARR >= 50k, onboarding_status != \"active\", last_touch > 60d. Exclude renewals < 30d. Will auto-enroll in 're-engage_onboarding' playbook + add tag 'onboard-stale-90'.
Sophie (RevOps): Please exclude pilots and proof-of-concepts. Also don't reassign accounts that are in 'deployment' bucket.
Maria (CS Ops): Yep — exclude segment = 'pilot' OR lifecycle_stage = 'deployment'.
Maria (CS Ops): Filter I'm running (dry-run first):
```
SELECT account_id, owner, ARR, onboarding_status, last_touch, renewal_days
FROM crm.accounts
WHERE ARR >= 50000
  AND onboarding_status NOT IN ('active','completed')
  AND last_touch < now() - interval '60 days'
  AND renewal_days > 30
  AND segment NOT IN ('pilot')
  AND lifecycle_stage != 'deployment';
```
Kai (Platform): I can wire the playbook rule in infra. Suggest a canary window: 10 accounts, notify owners first, then escalate to CSM team after 48h of no touch. Config snippet I can push: 
```
{
  "playbook_id": "reengage_onboard_v1",
  "canary_limit": 10,
  "actions": [
    {"type":"notify_owner","channel":"email"},
    {"type":"wait","duration":"48h"},
    {"type":"escalate","to":"CSM_team","tag":"onboard-stale-90"}
  ],
  "dry_run": true
}
```
Jamal (CS): Add custom field 'stale_reason' with enums: no-login, integration-blocker, waiting-legal, budget. That will help prioritization.
Maria (CS Ops): Good call. I'll add 'stale_reason' and 'feedback_note'. Dry-run now.
playbook-bot: Dry-run complete — 42 candidates matched. CSV generated: https://redwood.internal/drive/sweeps/1798765432-dryrun.csv
Maria (CS Ops): Quick scan: 3 accounts are owned by EM-only (no direct CSM) and 5 are flagged as 'integration-blocker' in last activity notes.
Sophie (RevOps): Can we suppress accounts with active SOW in procurement? Those will false positive.
Maria (CS Ops): Added procurement_exclusion = true to filter. Rerunning dry-run to confirm.
playbook-bot: Dry-run v2 complete — 34 candidates. Canary set to 10. Scheduling actual run for 02:00 UTC if no objections within 4h.
Jamal (CS): :thumbsup: Sounds good. For the actual run, please also push a tag 'cs:reengage-<date>' so we can query later.
Maria (CS Ops): Will do. Tag pattern: cs:reengage-2026-03-21. Also will populate 'stale_reason' where available from last interaction and include feedback_note template: 
```
Dear <owner>,
We've noticed <account> hasn't progressed through onboarding. Please mark stale_reason and next_action.
```
Kai (Platform): I'll flip dry_run=false after your final OK and send a deploy note. We'll add metrics: count_enrolled, owner_response_rate, avg_time_to_touch.
Jamal (CS): Please log all changes to the audit table with trace_id.
Maria (CS Ops): Done. I'll post the final CSV and the run summary in #customer-success after the run.
Sophie (RevOps): Thanks. Quick ask — can we add a rollback playbook that removes the tag if owner marks account 'active' within 24h?
Kai (Platform): yes — will add a conditional rollback step.
Maria (CS Ops): OK team — no objections in 3h, I'll kick the run at 02:00 UTC. Thanks everyone. :pray:
